notes: The School page has a People card: optional spots for your principal, vice principal, department head or subject group coordinator, curriculum coordinator and dean of academic affairs, each with a name and email. Change the spots to your school’s own roles.
A to-do can name people from the School page. Type “ask the principal” or a last name and they are picked out; open the to-do to add someone or write to them by email, and filter your list by person.
